content_sections.heading: TNSCPS Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Important: Candidates should ensure their completed application and relevant documents are submitted through one of the prescribed methods by 16 October 2026 at 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: TNSCPS Vacancy 2026: Post-Wise Details
content_sections.text: The notification announces 9 vacancies across seven post categories. Of these, 3 vacancies are for Assistant cum Data Entry Operator under TNSCPS.

content_sections.heading: TNSCPS Recruitment 2026 Educational Qualification and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Educational qualifications and work experience requirements vary according to the post. Applicants should check the eligibility for their selected position before submitting the application form. Applicants should possess a postgraduate degree in one of the following fields from a recognized university: Social Work Sociology Child Development Human Rights Public Administration Psychology Psychiatry Law Public Health Community Resource Management Alternatively, graduates in the specified fields with 2 years of experience in project formulation, implementation, monitoring or supervision may be considered under the notification's eligibility condition. Experience in Women and Child Development or Social Welfare is preferred. Computer proficiency is also required. Preference will be given to candidates possessing relevant knowledge and experience. Candidates must possess a graduate degree in Commerce or Mathematics from a recognized university. Applicants must also have: At least 1 year of experience working in the relevant field. Computer skills. Knowledge of Tally accounting software. 12th-pass candidates with the required computer qualification and work experience can apply for TNSCPS Assistant cum Data Entry Operator posts. The essential requirements are: Passed Class 12 from a recognized Board or equivalent Board. Diploma or Certificate in Computers. At least 1 year of experience working with a Government or Non-Government organization. There are 3 Assistant cum Data Entry Operator vacancies , each carrying a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 13,240 . Candidates must have passed Class 12 in the Commerce stream with Accounts group from a recognized Board or equivalent Board. Applicants must also possess: Diploma or Certificate in Computers. At least 1 year of experience working with a Government or Non-Government organization. Candidates should possess any degree under the 10+2+3 education pattern. Applicants should also have basic computer knowledge, including data entry, and fluency in English and Tamil. Candidates must be graduates with at least a Diploma in Computers, IT or a related field. Applicants should have a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in data management, process documentation, web-based reporting formats or video conferencing at State or District level, with Government, Non-Governmental or IT-based organizations. Preference will be given to candidates with previous experience in Child Helpline or other emergency helpline services.

content_sections.heading: TNSCPS Data Entry Operator Recruitment 2026: Can 12th-Pass Candidates Apply?
content_sections.text: Yes. Candidates who have passed Class 12 and possess a Diploma or Certificate in Computers can meet the educational qualification requirement for Assistant cum Data Entry Operator. However, the notification also requires at least one year of experience working with a Government or Non-Government organization. Therefore, passing Class 12 and having a computer certificate alone do not satisfy all the listed eligibility requirements.

content_sections.heading: Is Work Experience Mandatory for TNSCPS Data Entry Operator?
content_sections.text: Yes. The official notification requires at least 1 year of experience working with a Government or Non-Government organization for the Assistant cum Data Entry Operator post. Applicants should provide the relevant experience details and supporting certificates in the prescribed application form.

content_sections.heading: TNSCPS Recruitment 2026 Salary Details
content_sections.text: The selected candidates will receive monthly consolidated pay according to their post. The notification describes these amounts as consolidated monthly pay for contractual and purely temporary appointments.

content_sections.heading: TNSCPS Recruitment 2026 Job Responsibilities
content_sections.text: The Assistant cum Data Entry Operator will support data management and administrative functions relating to child welfare and protection activities. The responsibilities include: Maintaining databases, archives and filing systems. Creating and exporting spreadsheets, documents and data reports. Maintaining monthly reports in coordination with District Child Protection Units. Managing registers, email records and e-office files. Checking documents and data for errors or discrepancies. Updating State and Central child-related portals. Handling scanning, printing, filing and related clerical work. Working with MS Office, Google Suite and other office-management software. The Program Officer will assist in coordinating child protection activities, training, monitoring, project implementation and related welfare activities at State and District levels. The Accounts Officer's responsibilities include budget preparation, financial monitoring, expenditure reporting, maintenance of financial records and coordination of audits and financial compliance activities. The IT Supervisor will handle technical support for the Child Helpline, data privacy, management information systems, reporting, call-quality monitoring and related technological operations.

content_sections.heading: Is TNSCPS Recruitment 2026 Permanent or Contractual?
content_sections.text: The official notification clearly states that appointments under this recruitment are contractual and purely temporary . Applicants should consider the notified vacancies as temporary contractual opportunities rather than permanent government appointments.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TNSCPS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must complete the prescribed application form and submit it with relevant supporting documents through one of the accepted methods. Visit the official website mentioned in the recruitment notification or obtain the prescribed application form included with the notification. Read the qualification, age and experience requirements for the selected post. Select the post for which you are applying. Enter your personal details, including name, date of birth, contact information and address. Provide educational and additional qualification details. Enter your work experience details, including organization, designation and duration. Attach copies of the relevant educational and experience certificates and other supporting documents. Affix a passport-size photograph in the specified space. Complete and sign the declaration. Submit the completed form by post, in person or through the specified email address before the deadline. Candidates can submit their applications by email to: [email protected] Applications submitted through the prescribed email address, by post or in person must be completed within the deadline of 16 October 2026, 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for TNSCPS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The prescribed application form asks for supporting documents relevant to the information provided by the candidate. Proof of date of birth. Educational qualification certificates. Additional qualification certificates, if applicable. Relevant work experience certificates. Passport-size photograph. Completed and signed application form. The application form specifically states that all fields are mandatory. Incomplete applications or applications without relevant supporting documents will be rejected without prior information.

content_sections.heading: TNSCPS Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The supplied recruitment notification does not specify a particular written examination, interview format or detailed selection schedule. Candidates should refer to official communications from the recruiting Directorate for subsequent selection-related information.
